ko.title: 미주리 판사, 공화당이 그린 선거구 지도에 대한 주민투표 이의 제기 기각… 올가을 새로운 선거구 확정 길 열려

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: 미주리주 콜 카운티 순회법원 판사는 미주리주의 주민투표 절차가 주정부의 새로 그려진 연방 하원선거구 지도를 저지하는 데 사용될 수 없다고 판결했으며, 이는 11월 중간선거를 앞두고 오랫동안 민주당의 아성과 같았던 곳의 경계를 공화당이 재조정하는 데 있어 주요 법적 장애물을 제거하는 결정입니다.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## 판결 내용

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: 법원 서류에 따르면, 판사는 공화당이 주도하는 주의회가 올해 초 승인한 선거구 재조정 법안이 미주리주의 주민투표 절차에 따라 효력이 정지되고 전주(全州) 투표에 부쳐질 수 있는 성격의 조치에 해당하지 않는다고 판단했습니다.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: 선거구 지도에 반대하는 이들은 올해 선거 이전에 새로운 선거구 경계를 지연시키거나 뒤집을 수 있었던 주민 투표를 강제하기 위해 서명을 모으고 있었습니다.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: 주민투표의 길이 사실상 차단됨에 따라, 상급 법원이 개입하지 않는 한 새로 그려진 선거구 지도는 2026년 선거 주기부터 효력을 발휘할 태세를 갖추게 되었습니다.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: 이 사건에 연루된 변호인들은 미주리주 대법원 항소가 유력함을 시사했으며, 이는 화요일의 판결이 공화당에 상당한 절차적 승리를 안겨주었음에도 불구하고 선거구 지도를 둘러싼 싸움이 아직 끝난 것이 아님을 의미합니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## 선거구 지도가 논란이 되는 이유

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: 미주리주 공화당원들은 특별 입법 회기 동안 주의 연방 하원선거구를 다시 그렸으며, 지지자들은 이를 인구 변화를 반영하기 위한 일상적인 업데이트라고 묘사한 반면 비평가들은 공격적이고 당파적인 10년 주기 중반의 재조정이라고 규정했습니다.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: 새로운 경계는 현재 민주당 소속인 에마뉘엘 클리버 하원의원이 차지하고 있는 캔자스시티 기반의 제5선거구를 재구성하여,

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: 선거구 내 민주당 성향 유권자층의 일부를 인접한 공화당 성향이 더 강한 선거구로 이동시킵니다.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: 2005년부터 이 선거구를 대표해 온 클리버 의원은 새로운 선거구 경계가 캔자스시티의 흑인 및 민주당 커뮤니티의 투표권을 희석시키려는 시도라고 비판했습니다.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: 공화당 의원들은 선거구 경계를 설정할 주의회의 헌법적 권한을 정당하게 행사한 것이라고 선거구 지도를 옹호하며, 10년 주기 중반의 선거구 재조정이 흔치 않기는 하지만 다른 주에서도 선례가 없는 것은 아니라고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: 미주리주의 이러한 움직임은 또한 여러 주에서 중간선거 전 중간 주기 지도 변경을 통해 양당이 추가 하원 의석을 확보하려 함에 따라 올해 벌어지고 있는 광범위한 전국적 선거구 재조정 싸움과도 연관되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## 주민투표 공방

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: 미주리주 헌법은 시민들이 많은 새로운 법률에 대해 공공 주민투표를 청원할 수 있도록 허용하며, 주최 측이 정해진 기간 내에 충분한 유효 서명을 모으면 유권자들이 의견을 표명할 때까지 실질적으로 시행을 일시 중단시킵니다.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: 민주당 관리들과 투표권 단체를 포함한 새로운 연방 하원선거구 지도 반대파들은 미주리주 주민들이 선거구가 어떻게 그려지는지에 대해 최종 발언권을 가져야 한다고 주장하며 서명 운동을 시작했습니다.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: 공화당 지도부의 지지를 받는 주 정부는 선거구 재조정 입법이 주민투표 대상이 되는 법률 범주에 속하지 않는다고 반박하며, 미주리주 법률에서 특정 조치를 절차에서 제외하는 조항들을 지적했습니다.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: 콜 카운티 판사의 판결은 그 주장의 손을 들어주었으나, 정확한 법적 논거는 항소 과정에서 면밀한 조사를 받을 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 다음 단계

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: 미주리주의 연방 하원 예비선거와 후보 등록 마감일이 다가오고 있기 때문에, 항소 시점은 결정적인 판도가 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: 선거 관리자들은 일반적으로 투표소를 인쇄하고 유권자들에게 자신이 속한 선거구를 알리기 위해 예비선거 훨씬 전에 최종 확정된 선거구 경계가 필요하며, 이는 일단 이의 제기가 접수되면 법원이 선거구 분쟁을 신속하게 해결해야 하는 압박에 직면함을 의미합니다.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: 이 판결이 유지될 경우, 공화당은 다가오는 가을 중간선거에서 새로운 선거구 경계를 사용할 수 있는 입지를 다지게 되며, 독립 분석가들은 이는 클리버 의원의 의석을 공화당 도전자에게 훨씬 더 경쟁력 있는 곳으로 만들 것이라고 평가했습니다.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: 민주당과 연대 단체들은 투표가 확정되기 전에 기존 선거구를 복원하거나 주민투표를 확보하기 위한 긴급 항소 가능성을 포함해 법적 옵션을 계속 추구할 것으로상대적으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: 이 사건은 전국적으로 진행 중인 선거구 재조정을 둘러싼 여러 법적 분쟁 중 하나이며, 그 결과는 다른 주들이 2026년 선거를 앞두고 유사한 선거구 지도 변경에 어떻게 접근할지에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This is a developing legal story.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 현재 진행 중인 법적 사건 보도입니다.

segments.src: Details may be updated as court proceedings continue.*
segments.tr: 법원 절차가 진행됨에 따라 세부 사항이 업데이트될 수 있습니다.*

zh.title: 密苏里州法官驳回针对共和党划定选区地图的公投挑战，为今年秋季实施新选区界线扫清障碍

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: 密苏里州科尔县巡回法院法官裁定，密苏里州的公民公投程序不能用于阻止该州新划定的国会选区地图。这一裁决消除了共和党人在11月中期选举前重划长期由民主党控制的选区界线的一个重大法律障碍。

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## 裁决内容

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: 根据法庭文件，法官认定，共和党控制的立法机构今年早些时候批准的重新划分选区法案，不属于密苏里州公投程序中可以暂停并进行全州投票的措施类型。

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: 地图的反对者此前一直在收集签名，希望强制进行公众投票，这本可能在今年的选举前推迟或推翻新的选区界线。

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: 随着公投途径目前实际上已被关闭，除非上级法院进行干预，否则重新划分的地图有望在2026年选举周期生效。

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: 参与此案的律师表示，很可能会向密苏里州最高法院提起上诉，这意味着尽管周二的裁决让共和党在程序上取得了重大胜利，但围绕该地图的斗争远未结束。

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## 地图为何引发争议

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: 密苏里州共和党人在一次特别立法会议期间重新划分了该州的国会选区。支持者称此举是为了反映人口变化而进行的常规更新，而批评者则将其定性为激进的、十年中期的党派重划。

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: 新的界线重新配置了以堪萨斯城为中心的第5国会选区，该选区目前由民主党众议员

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: Emanuel Cleaver 担任，通过将该选区内倾向民主党的选民基础转移到邻近更倾向共和党的选区来实现。

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: 自2005年以来一直代表该选区的 Cleaver 称，新的界线是试图削弱堪萨斯城黑人和民主党社区的投票权。

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: 共和党议员为该地图辩护称，这是立法机构行使宪法赋予的划定选区界线权力的合法行为，并指出十年中期的重新划分选区虽然不常见，但在其他州并非没有先例。

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: 密苏里州的这一举措也与今年在全国范围内展开的更广泛的重新划分选区之争有关，因为两党都希望通过在多个州进行周期中期的地图变更，在中期选举前争取更多的众议院席位。

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## 公投之争

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: 密苏里州宪法允许公民就许多新法律请愿进行公众公投，如果组织者在规定时间内收集到足够的有效签名，实际上可以暂停法律的实施，直到选民发表意见。

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: 包括民主党官员和投票权团体在内的新国会地图反对者发起了签名运动，认为密苏里州人应该对如何划定他们的选区拥有最终决定权。

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: 在共和党领导人的支持下，州政府反驳称，重新划分选区的立法不属于公投适用的法律类别，并指出密苏里州法律中有条款将某些措施排除在公投程序之外。

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: 科尔县法官的裁决支持了这一论点，尽管确切的法律推理预计在上诉时将面临严格审查。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: 由于密苏里州的国会初选和候选人登记截止日期临近，任何上诉的时间安排都可能起到决定性作用。

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: 选举管理人员通常需要在初选前很早确定最终的选区界线，以便印制选票并告知选民他们属于哪个选区，这意味着一旦提出挑战，法院往往面临迅速解决地图争议的压力。

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: 如果裁决成立，共和党将能够利用新的界线参加秋季中期选举，独立分析人士表示，这一转变将使 Cleaver 的席位对共和党挑战者而言竞争性显著增强。

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: 预计民主党及其盟友团体将继续寻求法律途径，包括可能的紧急上诉，希望在选票最终确定前恢复旧地图或确保进行公众投票。

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: 此案是全国范围内多起关于十年中期重新划分选区的法律纠纷之一，其结果可能会影响其他州在2026年选举前处理类似地图变更的方式。

segments.src: *This is a developing legal story.
segments.tr: *这是一个正在发展的法律新闻。

segments.src: Details may be updated as court proceedings continue.*
segments.tr: 随着法庭程序的继续，细节可能会更新。*

hi.title: मिसौरी के न्यायाधीश ने GOP द्वारा तैयार किए गए नक्शे को चुनौती देने वाले जनमत संग्रह को खारिज किया, इस गिरावट में नई जिला सीमाओं के लिए रास्ता साफ

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: कोल काउंटी के एक सर्किट न्यायाधीश ने फैसला सुनाया है कि मिसौरी की नागरिक जनमत संग्रह प्रक्रिया का उपयोग राज्य के नए तैयार किए गए कांग्रेसनल नक्शे को रोकने के लिए नहीं किया जा सकता है, यह निर्णय नवंबर के मध्यावधि चुनावों से पहले डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टी के लंबे समय से गढ़ रहे क्षेत्र की सीमाओं को फिर से तैयार करने के रिपब्लिकन पार्टी के प्रयासों के सामने आने वाली एक बड़ी कानूनी बाधा को दूर करता है।

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## फैसले में क्या कहा गया है

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: अदालत में दायर दस्तावेजों के अनुसार, न्यायाधीश ने पाया कि इस साल की शुरुआत में रिपब्लिकन-नियंत्रित विधायिका द्वारा अनुमोदित पुनर्निर्धारण कानून उस प्रकार के उपाय के रूप में योग्य नहीं है जिसे मिसौरी की जनमत संग्रह प्रक्रिया के तहत निलंबित किया जा सके और राज्यव्यापी मतदान के लिए रखा जा सके।

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: नक्शे के विरोधियों ने सार्वजनिक मतदान कराने की उम्मीद में हस्ताक्षर एकत्र किए थे, जो इस साल के चुनावों से पहले नई सीमाओं में देरी कर सकता था या उन्हें पलट सकता था।

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: जनमत संग्रह का रास्ता फिलहाल प्रभावी रूप से बंद होने के साथ, नया नक्शा 2026 के चुनाव चक्र के लिए लागू होने की स्थिति में है, जब तक कि कोई उच्च अदालत हस्तक्षेप न करे।

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: मामले में शामिल वकीलों ने संकेत दिया है कि मिसौरी सुप्रीम कोर्ट में अपील की संभावना है, जिसका अर्थ है कि मंगलवार का फैसला रिपब्लिकन को एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रक्रियात्मक जीत दिलाने के बावजूद नक्शे को लेकर लड़ाई अभी खत्म नहीं हुई है।

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## नक्शा विवादास्पद क्यों है

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: मिसौरी के रिपब्लिकन ने एक विशेष विधायी सत्र के दौरान राज्य के कांग्रेसनल जिलों को फिर से तैयार किया, एक ऐसा कदम जिसे समर्थकों ने जनसंख्या परिवर्तनों को प्रतिबिंबित करने के लिए एक नियमित अपडेट बताया और आलोचकों ने इसे एक आक्रामक, दशक के मध्य में किया गया पक्षपातपूर्ण बदलाव बताया।

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: नई सीमाएं कंसास सिटी-आधारित 5वें कांग्रेसनल जिले को पुनर्गठित करती हैं, जो वर्तमान में डेमोक्रेटिक प्रतिनिधि

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: इमैनुएल क्लीवर के पास है, जिले के डेमोक्रेटिक-झुकाव वाले मतदाता आधार के कुछ हिस्सों को पड़ोसी, अधिक रिपब्लिकन-झुकाव वाले जिलों में स्थानांतरित करके।

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: क्लीवर, जो 2005 से जिले का प्रतिनिधित्व कर रहे हैं, ने नई सीमाओं को कंसास सिटी के अश्वेत और डेमोक्रेटिक समुदायों की मतदान शक्ति को कमजोर करने का प्रयास बताया है।

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: रिपब्लिकन सांसदों ने जिला सीमाओं को खींचने के लिए विधायिका के संवैधानिक अधिकार के वैध अभ्यास के रूप में नक्शे का बचाव किया है, यह देखते हुए कि दशक के मध्य में पुनर्निर्धारण, हालांकि असामान्य है, अन्य राज्यों में बिना मिसाल के नहीं है।

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: मिसौरी में इस प्रयास को इस साल चल रही एक व्यापक राष्ट्रीय पुनर्निर्धारण लड़ाई से भी जोड़ा गया है, क्योंकि दोनों पार्टियां कई राज्यों में मध्य-चक्र मानचित्र परिवर्तनों के माध्यम से मध्यावधि चुनावों से पहले अतिरिक्त हाउस सीटें हासिल करना चाहती हैं।

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## जनमत संग्रह की लड़ाई

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: मिसौरी का संविधान नागरिकों को कई नए कानूनों पर सार्वजनिक जनमत संग्रह के लिए याचिका दायर करने की अनुमति देता है, जो प्रभावी रूप से कार्यान्वयन को तब तक रोक देता है जब तक कि मतदाता अपनी राय न दे दें, बशर्ते आयोजक एक निर्धारित समय सीमा के भीतर पर्याप्त वैध हस्ताक्षर एकत्र कर लें।

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: नए कांग्रेसनल नक्शे के विरोधियों, जिनमें डेमोक्रेटिक अधिकारी और मतदान अधिकार समूह शामिल हैं, ने एक हस्ताक्षर अभियान शुरू किया था, जिसमें तर्क दिया गया था कि मिसौरी के लोगों के पास यह अंतिम निर्णय होना चाहिए कि उनके जिले कैसे तैयार किए जाएं।

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: राज्य ने, रिपब्लिकन नेताओं के समर्थन से, यह तर्क दिया कि पुनर्निर्धारण कानून जनमत संग्रह के लिए पात्र कानूनों की श्रेणियों से बाहर आता है, और मिसौरी कानून के उन प्रावधानों की ओर इशारा किया जो कुछ उपायों को प्रक्रिया से छूट देते हैं।

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: कोल काउंटी के न्यायाधीश का फैसला उस तर्क के पक्ष में था, हालांकि अपील पर सटीक कानूनी तर्क की बारीकी से जांच होने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: चूंकि मिसौरी का कांग्रेसनल प्राइमरी और फाइलिंग की समय सीमा नजदीक आ रही है, इसलिए किसी भी अपील का समय निर्णायक साबित हो सकता है।

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: चुनाव प्रशासकों को आमतौर पर मतपत्रों को प्रिंट करने और मतदाताओं को यह सूचित करने के लिए कि वे किस जिले से संबंधित हैं, प्राइमरी से काफी पहले अंतिम जिला सीमाओं की आवश्यकता होती है, जिसका अर्थ है कि एक बार चुनौती दायर होने के बाद अदालतों को अक्सर नक्शे के विवादों को जल्दी हल करने के दबाव का सामना करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: यदि फैसला कायम रहता है, तो रिपब्लिकन गिरावट के मध्यावधि चुनावों में नई सीमाओं का उपयोग करने की स्थिति में होंगे, एक ऐसा बदलाव जिसे स्वतंत्र विश्लेषकों ने कहा है कि यह क्लीवर की सीट को GOP चुनौती देने वाले के लिए काफी अधिक प्रतिस्पर्धी बना देगा।

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: डेमोक्रेट्स और संबद्ध समूहों से कानूनी विकल्पों का पीछा जारी रखने की उम्मीद है, जिसमें एक संभावित आपातकालीन अपील भी शामिल है, इस उम्मीद में कि पुराने नक्शे को बहाल किया जाए या मतपत्रों को अंतिम रूप देने से पहले सार्वजनिक मतदान सुरक्षित किया जाए।

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: यह मामला देश भर में दशक के मध्य में पुनर्निर्धारण को लेकर चल रहे कई कानूनी विवादों में से एक है, और इसका परिणाम यह प्रभावित कर सकता है कि अन्य राज्य 2026 के चुनावों से पहले इसी तरह के नक्शे परिवर्तनों के प्रति कैसे दृष्टिकोण अपनाते हैं।

segments.src: *This is a developing legal story.
segments.tr: *यह एक विकसित होती कानूनी कहानी है।

segments.src: Details may be updated as court proceedings continue.*
segments.tr: अदालत की कार्यवाही जारी रहने के साथ विवरण अपडेट किए जा सकते हैं.*

es.title: Un juez de Missouri rechaza el desafío al referéndum sobre el mapa trazado por el Partido Republicano, despejando el camino para nuevos límites distritales este otoño

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: Un juez de circuito del condado de Cole ha dictaminado que el proceso de referéndum ciudadano de Missouri no puede utilizarse para bloquear el mapa del Congreso recién trazado por el estado, una decisión que elimina un obstáculo legal importante para que los republicanos rediseñen los límites de un bastión demócrata de larga data antes de las elecciones intermedias de noviembre.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## Qué dice el fallo

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: Según los documentos judiciales, el juez determinó que la ley de redistribución de distritos aprobada por la legislatura controlada por los republicanos a principios de este año no califica como el tipo de medida que puede suspenderse y someterse a una votación estatal bajo el proceso de referéndum de Missouri.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: Los opositores al mapa habían estado recolectando firmas con la esperanza de forzar una votación pública que podría haber retrasado o anulado las nuevas líneas antes de las elecciones de este año.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: Con la vía del referéndum efectivamente cerrada por ahora, el mapa rediseñado está posicionado para entrar en vigor para el ciclo electoral de 2026, a menos que un tribunal superior intervenga.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: Los abogados involucrados en el caso han indicado que es probable una apelación ante la Corte Suprema de Missouri, lo que significa que la lucha por el mapa está lejos de terminar, incluso cuando el fallo del martes otorga a los republicanos una victoria procesal significativa.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## Por qué el mapa es controvertido

segments.tr: Los republicanos de Missouri rediseñaron los distritos del Congreso del estado durante una sesión legislativa especial, una medida que los partidarios describieron como una actualización de rutina para reflejar los cambios demográficos y que los críticos caracterizaron como un rediseño partidista agresivo a mitad de la década.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: Los nuevos límites reconfiguran el 5º Distrito del Congreso con sede en Kansas City, actualmente ocupado por el representante demócrata

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: Emanuel Cleaver, al trasladar partes de la base electoral del distrito, de tendencia demócrata, a distritos vecinos con una tendencia más republicana.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: Cleaver, quien ha representado al distrito desde 2005, ha calificado las nuevas líneas como un intento de diluir el poder de voto de las comunidades negras y demócratas de Kansas City.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: Los legisladores republicanos han defendido el mapa como un ejercicio legítimo de la autoridad constitucional de la legislatura para trazar los límites de los distritos, señalando que la redistribución de distritos a mitad de la década, aunque inusual, no carece de precedentes en otros estados.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: El impulso en Missouri también se ha relacionado con una batalla nacional más amplia sobre la redistribución de distritos que se desarrolla este año, ya que ambos partidos buscan obtener escaños adicionales en la Cámara antes de las elecciones intermedias mediante cambios de mapas a mitad de ciclo en varios estados.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## La lucha por el referéndum

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: La constitución de Missouri permite a los ciudadanos solicitar un referéndum público sobre muchas leyes nuevas, pausando efectivamente la implementación hasta que los votantes opinen, siempre que los organizadores reúnan suficientes firmas válidas dentro de un plazo establecido.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: Los opositores al nuevo mapa del Congreso, incluidos funcionarios demócratas y grupos de derechos electorales, habían lanzado una campaña de recolección de firmas argumentando que los habitantes de Missouri deberían tener la última palabra sobre cómo se trazan sus distritos.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: El estado, respaldado por líderes republicanos, respondió que la legislación de redistribución de distritos queda fuera de las categorías de leyes elegibles para referéndum, señalando disposiciones en la ley de Missouri que eximen ciertas medidas del proceso.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: El fallo del juez del condado de Cole se inclinó por ese argumento, aunque se espera que el razonamiento legal exacto sea objeto de un escrutinio minucioso en la apelación.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sucede después

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: Debido a que las fechas límite para las primarias y la presentación de candidaturas al Congreso de Missouri se acercan, el momento de cualquier apelación podría resultar decisivo.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: Los administradores electorales generalmente necesitan los límites de los distritos finalizados con mucha antelación a una primaria para imprimir las boletas e informar a los votantes a qué distrito pertenecen, lo que significa que los tribunales a menudo enfrentan presión para resolver las disputas sobre mapas rápidamente una vez que se presenta un desafío.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.

ar.title: قاضي في ميسوري يرفض الطعن في الاستفتاء على الخريطة التي رسمها الجمهوريون، مما يمهد الطريق لخطوط دوائر انتخابية جديدة هذا الخريف

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: حكم قاضي دائرة مقاطعة كول بأن عملية الاستفتاء للمواطنين في ميسوري لا يمكن استخدامها لعرقلة خريطة الكونغرس التي رسمها الولاية حديثاً، وهو قرار يزيل عقبة قانونية رئيسية أمام الجمهوريين لإعادة رسم حدود معقل ديمقراطي طويل الأمد قبيل انتخابات التجديد النصفي في نوفمبر.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## ما يقوله الحكم

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: وفقاً لملفات المحكمة، وجد القاضي أن قانون إعادة تقسيم الدوائر الذي وافق عليه المجلس التشريعي الذي يسيطر عليه الجمهوريون في وقت سابق من هذا العام لا مؤهل كنوع من التدابير التي يمكن تعليقها وعرضها للتصويت على مستوى الولاية بموجب عملية الاستفتاء في ميسوري.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: كان معارضو الخريطة يجمعون التوقيعات على أمل فرض تصويت عام كان يمكن أن يؤخر أو يلغي الخطوط الجديدة قبل انتخابات هذا العام.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: مع إغلاق مسار الاستفتاء فعلياً في الوقت الحالي، فإن الخريطة المعاد رسمها مهيأة لدخول حيز التنفيذ لدورة انتخابات 2026، ما لم تتدخل محكمة أعلى.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: أشار المحامون المشاركون في القضية إلى أن الاستئناف أمام المحكمة العليا في ميسوري مرجح، مما يعني أن المعركة حول الخريطة لم تنته بعد حتى مع منح حكم يوم الثلاثاء الجمهوريين فوزاً إجرائياً كبيراً.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## لماذا الخريطة مثيرة للجدل

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: قام الجمهوريون في ميسوري بإعادة رسم دوائر الكونغرس في الولاية خلال جلسة تشريعية خاصة، وهي خطوة وصفها المؤيدون بأنها تحديث روتيني يعكس التغييرات السكانية والتي وصفها النقاد بأنها إعادة رسم حزبية عدوانية في منتصف العقد.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: تعيد الحدود الجديدة تكوين الدائرة الانتخابية الخامسة في الكونغرس ومقرها كانساس سيتي، والتي يمثلها حالياً النائب الديمقراطي.

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: إيمانويل كليفر، من خلال نقل أجزاء من قاعدة الناخبين ذات الميل الديمقراطي في الدائرة إلى دوائر مجاورة تميل أكثر نحو الجمهوريين.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: وصف كليفر، الذي يمثل الدائرة منذ عام 2005، الخطوط الجديدة بأنها محاولة لتخفيف القوة التصويتية للمجتمعات السوداء والديمقراطية في كانساس سيتي.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: دافع المشرعون الجمهوريون عن الخريطة باعتبارها ممارسة مشروعة لسلطة المجلس التشريعي الدستورية لرسم حدود الدوائر، مشيرين إلى أن إعادة تقسيم الدوائر في منتصف العقد، وإن كانت غير معتادة، ليست بدون سوابق في ولايات أخرى.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: كما تم ربط الضغط في ميسوري بمعركة أوسع نطاقاً لإعادة تقسيم الدوائر على مستوى البلاد تدور رحاها هذا العام، حيث يتطلع كلا الحزبين إلى انتزاع مقاعد إضافية في مجلس النواب قبل الانتخابات النصفية من خلال تغييرات الخرائط في منتصف الدورة في عدة ولايات.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## معركة الاستفتاء

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: يسمح دستور ميسوري للمواطنين بتقديم عريضة لإجراء استفتاء عام على العديد من القوانين الجديدة، مما يؤدي فعلياً إلى وقف التطبيق حتى يبدي الناخبون رأيهم، شريطة أن يجمع المنظمون ما يكفي من التوقيعات الصحيحة خلال نافذة زمنية محددة.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: كان معارضو خريطة الكونغرس الجديدة، بما في ذلك المسؤولون الديمقراطيون ومجموعات حقوق التصويت، قد أطلقوا حملة لجمع التوقيعات محتجين بأن مواطني ميسوري يجب أن تكون لهم الكلمة الأخيرة حول كيفية رسم دوائرهم الانتخابية.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: ردت الولاية، بدعم من القادة الجمهوريين، بأن تشريع إعادة تقسيم الدوائر يقع خارج فئات القوانين المؤهلة للاستفتاء، مشيرة إلى نصوص في قانون ميسوري تعفي تدابير معينة من العملية.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: انحاز حكم قاضي مقاطعة كول إلى هذا Argument، على الرغم من أنه من المتوقع أن يواجه التفكير القانوني الدقيق تدقيقاً وثيقاً عند الاستئناف.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## ما سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن الانتخابات التمهيدية للكونغرس في ميسوري والمواعيد النهائية لتقديم الترشيحات اقتربت، فإن توقيت أي استئناف قد يكون حاسماً.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: يحتاج مسؤولو الانتخابات عموماً إلى خطوط دوائر نهائية قبل وقت كافٍ من الانتخابات التمهيدية لطباعة بطاقات الاقتراع وإبلاغ الناخبين بالدائرة التي ينتمون إليها، مما يعني أن المحاكم غالباً ما تواجه ضغوطاً لحل نزاعات الخرائط بسرعة بمجرد تقديم الطعن.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: إذا صمد الحكم، فسيكون الجمهوريون في وضع يسمح لهم باستخدام الخطوط الجديدة في الانتخابات النصفية الخريفية، وهو تحول قال المحللون المستقلون إنه سيجعلك مقعد كليفر أكثر تنافسية بشكل ملحوظ أمام منافس جمهوري.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: من المتوقع أن يواصل الديمقراطيون والمجموعات الحليفة متابعة الخيارات القانونية، بما في ذلك احتمال تقديم استئناف طارئ، على أمل استعادة الخريطة الأقدم أو تأمين تصويت عام قبل وضع اللمسات الأخيرة على بطاقات الاقتراع.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.

fr.title: Un juge du Missouri rejette la contestation par référendum de la carte dessinée par le GOP, ouvrant la voie à de nouvelles limites de circonscriptions cet automne

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: Un juge du circuit du comté de Cole a statué que le processus de référendum d'initiative citoyenne du Missouri ne pouvait pas être utilisé pour bloquer la carte électorale fédérale nouvellement dessinée de l'État, une décision qui lève un obstacle juridique majeur pour les Républicains qui redessinent les limites d'un bastion démocrate de longue date avant les élections de mi-mandat de novembre.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## Ce que dit le jugement

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: Selon les documents judiciaires, le juge a estimé que la loi de redécoupage électoral approuvée par la législature contrôlée par les Républicains plus tôt cette année ne qualifie pas comme le type de mesure pouvant être suspendue et soumise à un vote à l'échelle de l'État dans le cadre du processus de référendum du Missouri.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: Les opposants à la carte avaient recueilli des signatures dans l'espoir de forcer un vote public qui aurait pu retarder ou annuler les nouvelles limites avant les élections de cette année.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: La voie du référendum étant effectivement fermée pour l'instant, la carte redécoupée est en mesure de prendre effet pour le cycle électoral de 2026, à moins qu'une juridiction supérieure n'intervienne.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: Les avocats impliqués dans l'affaire ont indiqué qu'un appel devant la Cour suprême du Missouri est probable, ce qui signifie que la bataille autour de la carte est loin d'être terminée, même si la décision de mardi donne aux Républicains une victoire de procédure importante.

segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la carte fait polémique

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: Emanuel Cleaver, en déplaçant des portions de la base électorale plutôt démocrate du district vers des districts voisins plus inclinés vers les Républicains.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: Cleaver, qui représente le district depuis 2005, a qualifié les nouvelles limites de tentative de diluer le pouvoir de vote des communautés noires et démocrates de Kansas City.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: Les législateurs républicains ont défendu la carte comme un exercice légitime du pouvoir constitutionnel de la législature pour tracer les limites des districts, notant que le redécoupage en cours de décennie, bien qu'inhabituel, n'est pas sans précédent dans d'autres États.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: La pression au Missouri est également liée à une bataille nationale plus large sur le redécoupage électoral qui se joue cette année, alors que les deux partis cherchent à obtenir des sièges supplémentaires à la Chambre avant les élections de mi-mandat grâce à des modifications de cartes en milieu de cycle dans plusieurs États.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## La bataille du référendum

segments.tr: La constitution du Missouri permet aux citoyens de demander un référendum populaire sur de nombreuses nouvelles lois, ce qui suspend de fait leur application jusqu'à ce que les électeurs se prononcent, à condition que les organisateurs rassemblent suffisamment de signatures valides dans un délai imparti.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: L'État, soutenu par les dirigeants républicains, a répliqué que la législation sur le redécoupage électoral ne relève pas des catégories de lois éligibles au référendum, soulignant des dispositions de la loi du Missouri qui exemptent certaines mesures de ce processus.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: A pressão no Missouri também foi vinculada a uma batalha nacional mais ampla de redistritamento que ocorre este ano, enquanto ambos os partidos buscam obter assentos adicionais na Câmara antes das eleições de meio de mandato por meio de mudanças de mapa em meio de ciclo em vários estados.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## A Luta pelo Referendo

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: A constituição do Missouri permite que os cidadãos entrem com petições para um referendo público sobre muitas novas leis, pausando efetivamente a implementação até que os eleitores se pronunciem, desde que os organizadores reunam assinaturas válidas suficientes dentro de um prazo estabelecido.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: O estado, apoiado por líderes republicanos, contrapôs que a legislação de redistritamento está fora das categorias de lei elegíveis para referendo, apontando para disposições na lei do Missouri que isentam certas medidas do processo.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next

in.title: Hakim Missouri Tolak Gugatan Referendum terhadap Peta Rancangan GOP, Membuka Jalan bagi Batas Distrik Baru Musim Gugur Ini

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: Seorang hakim sirkuit Cole County telah memutuskan bahwa proses referendum warga Missouri tidak dapat digunakan untuk memblokir peta kongres yang baru dirancang di negara bagian tersebut, sebuah keputusan yang menghilangkan hambatan hukum utama bagi Partai Republik untuk menggambar ulang batas-batas wilayah pertahanan lama Partai Demokrat menjelang pemilu paruh waktu November.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## Apa Isi Putusan Tersebut

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: Menurut berkas pengadilan, hakim menemukan bahwa undang-undang pembagian wilayah baru yang disetujui oleh legislatif yang dikuasai Partai Republik awal tahun ini tidak memenuhi syarat sebagai jenis tindakan yang dapat ditangguhkan dan diajukan ke pemungutan suara di seluruh negara bagian di bawah proses referendum Missouri.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: Penentang peta tersebut telah mengumpulkan tanda tangan dengan harapan dapat memaksakan pemungutan suara publik yang dapat menunda atau membatalkan batas-batas baru sebelum pemilu tahun ini.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: Dengan jalur referendum yang secara efektif tertutup untuk saat ini, peta yang digambar ulang tersebut diposisikan untuk mulai berlaku pada siklus pemilu 2026, kecuali jika pengadilan yang lebih tinggi melakukan intervensi.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: Para pengacara yang terlibat dalam kasus ini telah mengindikasikan kemungkinan banding ke Mahkamah Agung Missouri, yang berarti pertarungan memperebutkan peta tersebut masih jauh dari selesai meskipun putusan hari Selasa memberikan kemenangan prosedural yang signifikan bagi Partai Republik.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Peta Tersebut Kontroversial

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: Partai Republik Missouri menggambar ulang distrik kongres negara bagian tersebut selama sesi legislatif khusus, sebuah langkah yang digambarkan oleh para pendukung sebagai pembaruan rutin untuk mencerminkan perubahan populasi dan yang dikritik oleh para kritikus sebagai penggambaran ulang partisan pertengahan dekade yang agresif.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: Batas-batas baru tersebut mengonfigurasi ulang Distrik Kongres ke-5 yang berbasis di Kansas City, yang saat ini dipegang oleh Perwakilan Demokrat

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: Emanuel Cleaver, dengan menggeser sebagian basis pemilih yang cenderung memilih Demokrat di distrik tersebut ke distrik tetangga yang lebih cenderung memilih Republik.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: Cleaver, yang telah mewakili distrik tersebut sejak 2005, menyebut batas-batas baru itu sebagai upaya untuk melemahkan kekuatan suara komunitas Kulit Hitam dan Demokrat di Kansas City.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: Anggota legislatif dari Partai Republik membela peta tersebut sebagai pelaksanaan sah dari otoritas konstitusional legislatif untuk menggambar batas distrik, dengan mencatat bahwa pembagian wilayah baru di pertengahan dekade, meskipun tidak biasa, bukan tanpa preseden di negara bagian lain.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: Upaya di Missouri ini juga dikaitkan dengan pertarungan pembagian wilayah nasional yang lebih luas yang terjadi tahun ini, karena kedua partai berupaya memperebutkan kursi tambahan di DPR menjelang pemilu paruh waktu melalui perubahan peta di pertengahan siklus di beberapa negara bagian.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## Pertarungan Referendum

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: Konstitusi Missouri mengizinkan warga negara untuk mengajukan petisi referendum publik atas banyak undang-undang baru, yang secara efektif menghentikan sementara implementasi sampai pemilih memberikan suara, asalkan penyelenggara mengumpulkan cukup tanda tangan yang sah dalam jangka waktu yang ditentukan.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: Penentang peta kongres baru, termasuk pejabat Demokrat dan kelompok hak pilih, telah meluncurkan pengumpulan tanda tangan dengan argumen bahwa warga Missouri harus memiliki keputusan akhir tentang bagaimana distrik mereka digambar.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: Negara bagian, yang didukung oleh para pemimpin Republik, membalas bahwa undang-undang pembagian wilayah baru berada di luar kategori undang-undang yang memenuhi syarat untuk referendum, menunjuk pada ketentuan dalam undang-undang Missouri yang membebaskan tindakan tertentu dari proses tersebut.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: Putusan hakim Cole County berpihak pada argumen tersebut, meskipun penalaran hukum yang tepat diperkirakan akan menghadapi pengawasan ketat dalam banding.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: Karena tenggat waktu pendaftaran dan pemilihan pendahuluan kongres Missouri sudah dekat, waktu pengajuan banding apa pun dapat menjadi penentu.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.

segments.tr: この訴訟に関与している弁護士らは、ミズーリ州最高裁判所への上訴の可能性が高いことを示唆しており、火曜日の判決により共和党が手続き上の大きな勝利を得たものの、地図をめぐる闘いはまだ終わっていません。

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial

segments.tr: 共和党議員らは、中間年の再画定は異例ではあるものの他州で前例がないわけではないと指摘し、この地図は選挙区の境界線を画定するという議会の憲法上の権限の正当な行使であると擁護しています。

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight

segments.src: ## What Happens Next

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.

segments.src: A Cole County circuit judge has ruled that Missouri's citizen referendum process cannot be used to block the state's newly drawn congressional map, a decision that removes a major legal obstacle to Republicans redrawing the boundaries of a longtime Democratic stronghold ahead of the November midterms.
segments.tr: Ein Richter am Bezirksgericht des Cole County hat entschieden, dass der Bürgerreferendumsprozess in Missouri nicht genutzt werden kann, um die neu gezeichnete Kongresswahlkarte des Staates zu blockieren. Diese Entscheidung beseitigt ein großes rechtliches Hindernis für die Republikaner, die die Grenzen einer langjährigen demokratischen Hochburg vor den Zwischenwahlen im November neu ziehen wollen.

segments.src: ## What the Ruling Says
segments.tr: ## Was das Urteil besagt

segments.src: According to court filings, the judge found that the redistricting law approved by the Republican-controlled legislature earlier this year does not qualify as the type of measure that can be suspended and put to a statewide vote under Missouri's referendum process.
segments.tr: Gerichtsakten zufolge befand der Richter, dass das zu Beginn dieses Jahres vom republikanisch kontrollierten Parlament verabschiedete Gesetzes zur Neugliederung der Wahlbezirke nicht zu der Art von Maßnahmen gehört, die im Rahmen des Referendumsprozesses von Missouri ausgesetzt und einer landesweiten Abstimmung unterzogen werden können.

segments.src: Opponents of the map had been collecting signatures in hopes of forcing a public vote that could have delayed or overturned the new lines before this year's elections.
segments.tr: Gegner der Karte hatten Unterschriften gesammelt, in der Hoffnung, eine Volksabstimmung zu erzwingen, die die neuen Grenzen vor den diesjährigen Wahlen hätte verzögern oder kippen können.

segments.src: With the referendum route effectively closed off for now, the redrawn map is positioned to take effect for the 2026 election cycle, unless a higher court intervenes.
segments.tr: Da der Weg über ein Referendum vorerst effektiv versperrt ist, wird die neu gezeichnete Karte für den Wahlzyklus 2026 in Kraft treten, es sei denn, ein höheres Gericht greift ein.

segments.src: Attorneys involved in the case have indicated an appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court is likely, meaning the fight over the map is far from over even as Tuesday's ruling hands Republicans a significant procedural win.
segments.tr: An dem Fall beteiligte Anwälte haben signalisiert, dass eine Berufung beim Obersten Gerichtshof von Missouri wahrscheinlich ist, was bedeutet, dass der Kampf um die Karte noch lange nicht vorbei ist, auch wenn das Urteil vom Dienstag den Republikanern einen bedeutenden verfahrensrechtlichen Sieg beschert.

segments.src: ## Why the Map Is Controversial
segments.tr: ## Warum die Karte umstritten ist

segments.src: Missouri Republicans redrew the state's congressional districts during a special legislative session, a move that supporters described as a routine update to reflect population changes and that critics characterized as an aggressive, mid-decade partisan redraw.
segments.tr: Die Republikaner in Missouri haben die Kongresswahlbezirke des Staates während einer Sondersitzung des Parlaments neu gezeichnet – ein Schritt, den Befürworter als routinemäßige Aktualisierung zur Widergabe von Bevölkerungsveränderungen und den Kritiker als aggressiven, parteiischen Neuzuschnitt mitten im Jahrzehnt beschrieben.

segments.src: The new boundaries reconfigure the Kansas City-based 5th Congressional District, currently held by Democratic Rep.
segments.tr: Die neuen Grenzen konfigurieren den auf Kansas City ausgerichteten 5. Kongresswahlbezirk, der derzeit vom demokratischen Abgeordneten

segments.src: Emanuel Cleaver, by shifting portions of the district's Democratic-leaning voter base into neighboring, more Republican-leaning districts.
segments.tr: Emanuel Cleaver gehalten wird, um, indem sie Teile der demokratisch gesinnten Wählerschaft des Bezirks in benachbarte, eher republikanisch gesinnte Bezirke verlegen.

segments.src: Cleaver, who has represented the district since 2005, has called the new lines an attempt to dilute the voting power of Kansas City's Black and Democratic communities.
segments.tr: Cleaver, der den Bezirk seit 2005 vertritt, hat die neuen Grenzen als Versuch bezeichnet, die Stimmabgabemacht der schwarzen und demokratischen Gemeinschaften in Kansas City zu verwässern.

segments.src: Republican lawmakers have defended the map as a legitimate exercise of the legislature's constitutional authority to draw district boundaries, noting that mid-decade redistricting, while unusual, is not without precedent in other states.
segments.tr: Republikanische Abgeordnete haben die Karte als legitime Ausübung der verfassungsmäßigen Befugnis des Parlaments zur Festlegung von Wahlkreisgrenzen verteidigt und dabei angemerkt, dass eine Neugliederung mitten im Jahrzehnt zwar ungewöhnlich, in anderen Staaten jedoch nicht ohne Präzedenzfall ist.

segments.src: The push in Missouri has also been tied to a broader national redistricting battle playing out this year, as both parties look to squeeze out additional House seats ahead of the midterms through mid-cycle map changes in several states.
segments.tr: Der Vorstoß in Missouri steht auch im Zusammenhang mit einem größeren nationalen Streit um die Neugliederung von Wahlbezirken, der in diesem Jahr ausgetragen wird, da beide Parteien versuchen, durch Änderungen der Wahlkarten in der Mitte des Zyklus in mehreren Staaten zusätzliche Sitze im Repräsentantenhaus vor den Zwischenwahlen herauszuholen.

segments.src: ## The Referendum Fight
segments.tr: ## Der Kampf um das Referendum

segments.src: Missouri's constitution allows citizens to petition for a public referendum on many new laws, effectively pausing implementation until voters weigh in, provided organizers gather enough valid signatures within a set window.
segments.tr: Die Verfassung von Missouri erlaubt es Bürgerinnen und Bürgern, eine Petition für ein öffentliches Referendum über viele neue Gesetze einzureichen, wodurch die Umsetzung effektiv pausiert wird, bis die Wähler ihre Stimme abgeben, vorausgesetzt, die Organisatoren sammeln innerhalb eines festgelegten Zeitfensters genügend gültige Unterschriften.

segments.src: Opponents of the new congressional map, including Democratic officials and voting rights groups, had launched a signature drive arguing that Missourians should have the final say on how their districts are drawn.
segments.tr: Gegner der neuen Kongresskarte, darunter demokratische Amtsträger und Bürgerrechtsgruppen, hatten eine Unterschriftensammlung gestartet mit dem Argument, dass die Bürger von Missouri das letzte Wort darüber haben sollten, wie ihre Wahlbezirke gezeichnet werden.

segments.src: The state, backed by Republican leaders, countered that redistricting legislation falls outside the categories of law eligible for referendum, pointing to provisions in Missouri law that exempt certain measures from the process.
segments.tr: Der Staat, unterstützt von republikanischen Führungspersönlichkeiten, hielt dagegen, dass die Gesetzgebung zur Neugliederung außerhalb der für ein Referendum infrage kommenden Gesetzeskategorien liegt, und verwies auf Bestimmungen im Recht von Missouri, die bestimmte Maßnahmen von diesem Prozess ausnehmen.

segments.src: The Cole County judge's ruling sided with that argument, though the exact legal reasoning is expected to face close scrutiny on appeal.
segments.tr: Das Urteil des Richters im Cole County schloss sich diesem Argument an, wenngleich die genaue juristische Begründung bei einer Berufung voraussichtlich auf genaue Prüfung stoßen wird.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Wie es weitergeht

segments.src: Because Missouri's congressional primary and filing deadlines are approaching, the timing of any appeal could prove decisive.
segments.tr: Da die Vorwahlen und Einreichungsfristen für den Kongress in Missouri näher rücken, könnte sich der Zeitpunkt einer Berufung als entscheidend erweisen.

segments.src: Election administrators generally need finalized district lines well in advance of a primary to print ballots and inform voters which district they belong to, meaning courts often face pressure to resolve map disputes quickly once a challenge is filed.
segments.tr: Wahlleiter benötigen im Allgemeinen gut im Voraus vor einer Vorwahl fertiggestellte Wahlkreisgrenzen, um Stimmzettel zu drucken und die Wähler darüber zu informieren, zu welchem Bezirk sie gehören. Das bedeutet, dass Gerichte oft unter Druck stehen, Streitigkeiten über Wahlkarten schnell zu lösen, sobald eine Klage eingereicht wird.

segments.src: If the ruling stands, Republicans would be positioned to use the new lines in the fall midterms, a shift that independent analysts have said would make Cleaver's seat significantly more competitive for a GOP challenger.
segments.tr: Sollte das Urteil Bestand haben, wären die Republikaner in der Position, die neuen Grenzen bei den Zwischenwahlen im Herbst zu nutzen – ein Schritt, den unabhängige Analysten als Maßnahme bezeichnet haben, die Cleavers Sitz für einen republikanischen Herausforderer deutlich umkämpfter machen würde.

segments.src: Democrats and allied groups are expected to continue pursuing legal options, including a possible emergency appeal, in hopes of restoring the older map or securing a public vote before ballots are finalized.
segments.tr: Es wird erwartet, dass die Demokraten und verbündete Gruppen weiterhin rechtliche Optionen verfolgen, einschließlich einer möglichen Eilberufung, in der Hoffnung, die ältere Karte wiederherzustellen oder eine Volksabstimmung zu sichern, bevor die Stimmzettel endgültig gedruckt werden.

segments.src: The case is one of several ongoing legal disputes nationwide over mid-decade redistricting, and its outcome could influence how other states approach similar map changes in the run-up to the 2026 elections.
segments.tr: Der Fall ist einer von mehreren anhängigen Rechtsstreitigkeiten bundesweit über die Neugliederung von Wahlbezirken in der Mitte des Jahrzehnts, und sein Ausgang könnte beeinflussen, wie andere Staaten ähnliche Kartenänderungen im Vorfeld der Wahlen 2026 angehen.
